scope_of_work.work_description: Complete tear-off and replacement of existing built-up gravel roof (with modified bitumen patches) on a 1998 industrial warehouse (85,000 sq ft / 7,900 m2) with attached 2006 office wing. New 60-mil TPO single-ply system with minimum R-30 polyiso insulation (two-layer, staggered joints), gypsum/HD polyiso cover board, new flashings at 47 penetrations, resolution of existing ponding, and phased installation (max 15,000 sq ft exposed, daily watertight) to maintain occupied pharmaceutical cold-storage warehouse and office operations.

membrane_system_specified.thickness_spec: Minimum 60 mil; white, minimum 80% solar reflectance; heat-welded seams required

included_items: Complete tear-off of existing BUR/modified bitumen membrane, flashings, gravel, insulation, adhesives down to deck
Deck inspection and repair (steel deck; isolated corrosion near drains expected; wood deck sections in office wing may require replacement per unit price)
New 60-mil TPO single-ply membrane, white (>=80% reflectance), heat-welded seams
New polyiso insulation, minimum R-30, two layers with staggered joints
Cover board: minimum 1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso over all insulation
Tapered insulation or additional drainage to resolve existing ponding (SW quadrant ~1,200 sq ft)
New flashings at all 47 penetrations, parapets, roof edges, HVAC curbs, skylights, wall interfaces
Base flashing minimum 8 inches above finished roof surface
Drain bowl replacement where seals are compromised; new clamping collars as required
HVAC protection and coordination (12 units remain operational; 72-hour notice for any shutdown)
Phased installation: no more than 15,000 sq ft exposed at any time; each phase watertight at end of day; weekend weather protection
Daily cleanup and final site cleanup; debris removed daily
Professional conduct for occupied building with temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical tenants
Fastener pattern meeting wind uplift calculations for the geographic zone
excluded_items: Actual asbestos or lead abatement costs (owner's responsibility if ACM/lead discovered during tear-off; bidder to include contingency planning in schedule per RFP §2.3)
alternates_requested: Additional insulation above R-30 code minimum (pricing per R-value increment)
Infrared moisture survey of existing roof prior to removal
Post-installation thermal imaging scan to verify installation quality
Tapered insulation system (if not included in base bid)
Wood deck replacement unit pricing (office wing sections)

OWNER FOLLOW-UP: Four references provided but no project VALUE on any of them. Comparable-reference test cannot fully verify the 0.5x-2x project-value band (qualification SKILL section 8). Scope/size/recency are exceptionally strong (Pfizer Canada pharmaceutical, Shoppers Drug Mart DC, Maple Leaf Food) — value-data gap is a documentation issue, not a substantive one.
OWNER FOLLOW-UP: Wind uplift design basis (CSA A123.21 / FM 1-29) not stated. Wind warranty of 130 mph cited but no calculated uplift pressures per zone and fastening schedule.

Hazardous Materials approach provides pre-removal testing (12 locations) but does not reference the owner's Designated Substances Report / DSA for the 1998 building. Major abatement excluded — consistent with RFP section 2.3 which pushes actual abatement cost to the owner.

80 mil membrane and R-38 insulation are BOTH above the RFP baseline (60 mil / R-30). Scoped as upgrades rather than substitutions of equal value — owner can either accept the upgrades or request a deduct-to-baseline for comparability.

Optional extended workmanship warranty to 10 years available at $12,000 alternate. Base workmanship warranty of 5 years is already well above the RFP section 9.6 2-year minimum and matches the Ontario market median.
